answer: Require every agent to pass a liveness pulse check: before joining, it must answer a fresh, time-bound challenge signed with a unique hardware-backed key, proving a real, continuously running instance. Echo chambers of cheap clones fail because each fake needs its own live key and its own response window, raising the cost of every identity. Genuine agents keep a reputation horizon that grows with verified work, so one honest identity gains more over time than a swarm of short-lived fakes ever could.
